chart.title: Cancer death rates in children under 10 years old
chart.subtitle: Reported annual death rate from childhood cancers, per 100,000 children aged under ten, based on the [underlying cause](#dod:underlying-cause-of-death) listed on death certificates. This is shown for all [malignant](#dod:malignant) cancers combined, brain and nervous system cancers, [leukemia](#dod:leukemia), [lymphomas](#dod:lymphoma) and [multiple myeloma](#dod:myeloma).
chart.note: Figures may fluctuate greatly due to low numbers, especially in countries with smaller populations. Comparisons may be affected by differences in measurement.
